_note: EXAMPLE ONLY - layer A (SO-101 leader). Replace every value marked example_not_measured with a real reading before saving it through POST /ros-mobile/teleop/calibration. The store adds schema_version/kind/identity/created_utc/content_sha256/version itself.

device_identity.attached_to_note: the leader's USB identity is on the upper computer, not the car; network reachability is not serial access
device_identity.serial_is_the_only_stable_identity: all four adapters share VID:PID 1a86:55d3, so /dev/ttyACM* numbering drifts between boots; bind the calibration to the by-id serial only
device_identity.role_confirmed_by: 2026-10-31 unplug-one-cable audit on the upper host: 5B90149652=right_leader, 5B90149723=left_leader, 5B91045575=right_follower, 5B90149339=left_follower

units.gripper: 0-100 opening percent - never an angle and never converted with radians()

reference_pose_deg._note: recorded by the wizard when the operator parks the leader in the agreed rest pose

write_audit.calibrate_false_still_writes: yes - lerobot's teleoperate entry writes calibration files unconditionally, so calibrate=False does NOT mean 'no writes'
write_audit.torque_state_after_wizard: leader servos stay powered; the reader path uses Present_Position reads only
write_audit.reader_is_read_only: SO101LeaderReader only ever issues sync_read; connect(handshake=True) pings and reads, and disconnect is called with disable_torque=False so closing the reader never drops a loaded arm
write_audit.examples_do_not_bless_a_calibration_writ: layer A stores what the operator already calibrated elsewhere; saving this file writes no EEPROM

reader_config._note: tune against measured bus load; these are the defaults in lelab.mobile_leader_reader.LeaderConfig

source.note: the lerobot file carries no schema/version/identity, so this layer re-states the device identity and hashes it

lerobot_calibration_note: copy the dict produced by the existing SO-101 calibration wizard (HF_LEROBOT_CALIBRATION/teleoperators/<task>/<rig>.json). These five fields per motor are what let the bus report degrees and 0-100 percent; without them the reader refuses to open rather than read raw ticks.
